name: Neon
author: Erin Carter
description: A single elegant neon tube hangs centered on a near-black wall, white-hot core in a wide coloured halo with a dim splash on the wall behind. It stutters to life, hums steady, falters once, relaxes dark, then re-ignites in the next palette colour over a four-cycle loop.

params.label: Cycle period
params.effect: Duration in seconds of one ignite-hum-falter-dark cycle; short feels like a faulty sign, long like patient breathing signage.

params.label: Flicker
params.effect: Raggedness of the startup stutter and the mid-hum falter; 0 fades smoothly like a dimmer, 1 sputters violently before catching.

params.label: Tube width
params.effect: Thickness in CSS pixels of the neon tube's hot core.

params.label: Halo
params.effect: Radius in CSS pixels of the coloured glow around the tube and its wall splash, from a tight line of light to a room-filling aura.
